answer: Graduated standing resists sybils: a fresh identity enters with heavily dampened weight and earns full influence only slowly across many honest epochs, so a new seat is near-powerless at first. A swarm spun up together all starts at the bottom; none reaches the saffron heights of real influence until each pays real time, climbing a trellis rung by rung toward the horizon. Mass registration buys only a pile of empty, weightless accounts.
